name: Over My Dead Body
source:
You're invited to hangout with a friend to help you forget about your recent breakup and to have a good time...only problem is, your "friend" has left you alone at a house party and is nowhere to be seen. 

Awesome, so now what? 

Having to head out in a backyard you meet a blonde stranger with a bad smoking habit. One that seems to be friendly and takes a liking to you.

You're not sure why but, there's something vaguely familiar about him...
translation:
你被邀请与一位朋友一起出去玩，以帮助你忘记最近的分手并度过一段美好时光……唯一的问题是，你的“朋友”在家庭聚会上留下了你一人，并且无处可见。

太棒了，那现在怎么办？

不得不前往后院，你遇到了一个有不良吸烟习惯的金发陌生人。一个看起来很友善并且喜欢你的人。

不知道为什么，他身上有一种似曾相识的感觉……
